cases.construction: Six deterministic 256-dimensional vectors. raw[row,d]=Float32(sin(Double((row+1)*(d+1))*0.037)+0.31*cos(Double((row+3)*(d+2))*0.019)+Double((row*17+d*3)%7-3)*0.001); compute the norm from the widened Float32 raw coordinates in Double, divide in Double, and round every normalized coordinate to Float32.
cases.name: normalized-vectors

cases.construction: Eight 256-dimensional inputs based on the exact graph Float32 mean1: unchanged mean1; coordinate 0 changed by both signs of 0.5e-6, 1e-6, and 2e-6 using Float32 addition; and all 256 coordinates changed by Float32(0.5e-6/16) using Float32 addition. Stored values are the exact Float32 inputs after rounding.
cases.name: first-norm-floor

cases.construction: One all-zero 256-dimensional input followed by positive and negative coordinate unit vectors on axes 0, 1, 63, 127, 128, and 255. These inputs are exact Float32 values.
cases.name: edge-vectors

metadata.comparisonRule: psi is the JSON float32 tensor widened to float64 without transformation; referenceProjection and referenceSqrtSpectrum are exact float32 tensors read from the model's weights. coordinateSigns is sign(row[argmax(abs(row))]) for each reference projection row, scanning left-to-right and replacing a maximum only on strict greater-than so ties retain the lowest coordinate. rho is stored as float64 values widened from the model's float32 output. Portable comparison uses signed per-coordinate absolute error <= 1e-4 with the stored coordinate orientation; sign-invariant comparison is not accepted. The cases exercise the first normalization floor only; they do not claim to exercise the second normalization floor.
metadata.inputConstruction: The oracle loads only the caller-provided PldaRho.mlmodelc using MLModel(contentsOf:configuration:) with .cpuOnly, then runs the pinned FluidAudio 0.15.8 PLDATransform.transform. The input assets are plda-parameters.json and xvector-transform.json from FluidInference revision df2625ac79a7ac6b65ad868fee6d80f320da4232; their SHA-256 values are recorded at the top level. Every stored embedding is the exact Float32 value passed to FluidAudio. normalized-vectors has six deterministic sin/cos plus small-jitter rows normalized after Float32 rounding. first-norm-floor starts from the graph's exact Float32 mean1 and includes it unchanged, coordinate-0 perturbations of both signs at 0.5e-6, 1e-6, and 2e-6, and one all-coordinate 0.5e-6/16 perturbation (all values Float32-rounded). edge-vectors contains zero and positive/negative coordinate unit vectors for axes 0, 1, 63, 127, 128, and 255. Reference projection and sqrt spectrum are decoded from the Core ML BLOBFILE records after their 64-byte headers; graph declarations, shapes, offsets, and JSON parameter correspondence are checked. No alternate or portable inference implementation is used as the oracle.
